plugins.name: wilson-pool

Each host carries a platform tag â a macOS-only or Linux-only command is sent to a host of that platform, otherwise the load is round-robined across the roster. workdir may be explicit or `auto` (mirror the current project â a local ~/<rel> path runs at ~/<rel> on each host, so one setting works across roster hosts with different usernames), with an optional fallback path. Spirit-port of wilson's pool roster. CAVEAT: a CC hook cannot mount the caller fs (wilson uses 9P/sshfs) â the user must keep the remote workdir synced on every roster host; routing is OFF until the roster has >=1 host AND workdir is set; only Bash is routed.
